notes: The main results list (ul.results) holds 25 li.booklink entries; each has exactly one link, to the book's /ebooks/<number> detail page, and that link is the item. Author names, cover images and download counts sit inside that same single link, so there are no separate author links to exclude. Excluded: the sort-order links (Release Date, Title, Random), the two 'Next' pagination links, and the header/footer navigation. The page lists results 1-25 of the downloads-sorted search. Grading caveat: 'https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11' (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland) is a prefix of 'https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1184' (The Count of Monte Cristo), so under contains-matching the Alice item also matches a Monte Cristo result.
